verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe isolated Linux microVMs and SDKs (`@vercel/sandbox`) that programmatically create sandboxes. There is also a one-line CLI path (`sandbox create --name`, `sandbox run`) that boots from a ready-to-use default image with Node.js, Python and common tools, and production authentication is automatic. The "in seconds" part is not quantified; the docs only say snapshots are faster than creating from scratch. missing for 10: documented boot/startup latency figures, an explicit one-call SDK create example, independent or hands-on corroboration of provisioning speed.
